title: Clarification Required
description: Body for application/vnd.yaagents.clarification+json (HTTP 400). The agent requires additional inputs before it can proceed.

message.description: Human-readable description of the clarification requirement.

requiredInputs.description: One or more inputs the caller must supply to proceed.

trace.description: Correlation identifiers propagated from the inbound request.

requiredInput.description: A single input the caller must supply to proceed.

name.description: Field or parameter identifier the caller must supply.

location.description: Where in the request this input should be placed.

type.description: JSON type hint for the expected value.

required.description: Whether this input is mandatory to proceed.

question.description: Human-readable prompt surfaced to the end user.

allowedValues.description: Optional enumeration of acceptable string values.
